importance_ranking.reason: High visual variation between sub-types — curtained ladies booth, open-frame frisking stand, and fully enclosed cabin with roof are visually distinct product forms. Buyers use the image to confirm product type before reading any text; wrong visual = immediate skip.

Booth configuration, size, and frame material are primary shortlisting criteria — a buyer needing a 4×4 ft wheeled ladies booth cannot substitute a 3×3 ft fixed open-frame stand. Listings without these specs cannot be evaluated for fit.

Price varies substantially with configuration (enclosed vs open-frame), material (ACP vs fabric), and size — buyers compare prices only after confirming spec equivalence. Institutional and bulk orders are always negotiated; listed price is a budget entry point.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: No dominant brand with buyer recall exists in this category — the market is fragmented across regional fabricators and no taxonomy sibling or market source surfaces a recognised brand that buyers search for by name.
importance_ranking.reason: Institutional buyers (government, PSU, airport operators) evaluate manufacturer status, prior government supply track record, and installation capability during vendor selection — seller credibility is a qualification gate, not a primary shortlisting signal.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Always per piece for any configuration or size variant. Bulk project orders (metro/airport) are quoted per piece with volume discount. No buyer ever questions the unit for a discrete prefabricated structure.
importance_ranking.reason: Unit is entirely implied by the product — a frisking booth is a discrete self-contained structure and no buyer would question whether it is sold per piece.

top_configurator_specs.reason: Defines the product class — 2-side-closed ladies booth vs 4-side-curtain open-frame stand are non-interchangeable across deployment contexts, with significant price and structural differences between values.

Determines the quality and durability tier — ACP-panel MS-frame is the premium commercial standard while fabric/cloth is the budget variant, with a significant price delta between values that drives buyer shortlisting.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Open-top vs fully roofed variants serve distinct deployment contexts — permanent airport and metro installations require a roof for weather protection, while standard mall/event booths are open-top — and this distinction materially affects price and structural specification.

top_rfq_specs.reason: Communicates the deployment requirement — portable wheeled, fixed permanent, or foldable — which determines which product line a seller can supply and whether the booth fits the buyer's operational context.
Determines the quality tier and price band — sellers need this to confirm they manufacture in the required material and to provide an accurate quote.

missing_important_specs.why_important: Sellers cannot determine which product applies or quote accurately without knowing how many sides are enclosed — a 2-side-closed ladies booth and a 4-side-curtain open-frame stand are structurally and commercially distinct products.
